context: Two cafe friends recap a ghost-themed bookshop event
purpose: Teach: 如く/無縁/作り出し/奪っ/残酷/幽霊/徒然/題し

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨日の「徒然なる夜話」、めっちゃ面白かったよ。
lines.en: That 'Idle Night Tales' event last night was absolutely fantastic.
lines.style: Open with genuine warmth and energy, eyes bright. Quick conversational pace. Leans forward slightly, eager to share enthusiasm without performing it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん。あの作家さん、「秋の幽霊譚」と題した短編集、もう読んだ?
lines.en: Yeah. Have you read that author's short-story collection yet — the one called 'Autumn Ghost Tales'?
lines.style: Soft lift of curiosity at the question. Gentle, intimate tone as if sharing something she loved. Slight pause before the title, savoring it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 読んだ。残酷な結末ばっかりだけど、空気を作り出した手腕が見事だった。
lines.en: I have. The endings are all brutal, but the way she builds atmosphere is just remarkable.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pace. Quiet conviction on 'remarkable.' Eyes slightly distant, calling back the reading experience. Genuine admiration without overstatement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 特に最後の話、村の幽霊が次々と若者の命を奪っていく描写、息が止まったわ。
lines.en: The last story especially — those village ghosts claiming young lives one by one. I couldn't breathe through it.
lines.style: Hushed, almost meditative. Slight breathiness on the opening. Pace slows around 'one by one.' Voice trails softly, still caught in the memory of the story.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 前作とは打って変わった文体で、まるで別人の如く成熟したよね。
lines.en: Her prose is completely different from her earlier work — it's like she's matured into a whole new writer.
lines.style: Reflective, deliberate tone. Light emphasis on the shift, not analytical but noticing. Quiet certainty. Speaks like she's thinking out loud to someone she trusts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 恐怖って意外と日常と無縁じゃないんだなって、しみじみ感じた。
lines.en: It makes you realize fear isn't really separate from everyday life at all — it really sank in for me.
lines.style: Low, almost contemplative whisper. Unhurried pace. The kind of delivery where she's still processing. Gentle vulnerability beneath the thought.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 次回作の発表、月末にあるって告知出てたよ。一緒に行こう。
lines.en: The announcement for her next book is at month-end. Let's go together.
lines.style: Warm, natural close. Gentle lift of hope in the invitation. Not demanding — offering as a gift to share. Steady, grounded eye-contact tone.
